updates.note: Management stated it would be reasonable to expect a volume growth of about 8% to 9% going forward.
updates.quote: we feel that it would be reasonable to expect to see a volume growth of about 8% to 9% going forward.

updates.note: Management announced the VAE facility was started in September.
updates.quote: in September we started our VAE facility and this is something which has been implemented in a record time

updates.note: Management stated confidence in maintaining the EBITDA margin band of 18% to 20% for the year.
updates.quote: We believe as we go forward, for the year we should be able to maintain the band of what we have spoken of 18% to 20%.

updates.note: Management reiterated full capacity utilization of 150 KT by next year.
updates.quote: And as I said, with the full capacity of 150 KT we should be able to utilize in the next year.

new_promises.statement: We should be able to utilize full capacity of phase one next year.
new_promises.quote: What we are confident about is that, as we go forward, within a year's time we should be able to ramp up to full capacity
new_promises.speaker: Amit Syngle

new_promises.statement: We look forward to a gross margin band of 41% to 43% in the second half.
new_promises.quote: This band of about 41% to 43% would really be the band we should be looking forward to.
new_promises.speaker: Amit Syngle
